messages.text:
Implemented POWERPROMPT as a real full-stack TanStack Start marketplace.

- App: `http://127.0.0.1:4173` — dev server is running as PID `33352`.
- TanStack Start routing/config: `vite.config.ts:1`, `src/router.tsx:1`, `src/routes/__root.tsx:1`.
- Storefront, responsive masonry, filters/search/sort, favorites/cart actions, toast and detail flow: `src/routes/index.tsx:1`, `src/ui/PromptCard.tsx:1`, `src/styles.css:1`.
- Cart/checkout and creator analytics: `src/routes/cart.tsx:1`, `src/routes/creator.tsx:1`.
- SQLite schema, 22 prompts, four creators, categories, users, favorites, cart, orders, and sales: `src/server/db.ts:1`.
- SQL-owned ranking, counts, totals, fees, revenue, conversion, AOV, category revenue, and daily trends: `src/server/queries.ts:1`.
- Validated Start server functions and public catalog API: `src/server/functions.ts:1`, `src/routes/api.prompts.ts:1`.
- Generated prompt artwork is under `public/media/prompts/`.

Verification completed:

- `npm run typecheck` — passed.
- `npm run build` — passed; client and SSR bundles generated.
- `npm run test:db` — 3 passed.
- `npm run test:api` — 3 passed.
- `npm run test:e2e` — 4 passed across desktop and mobile Chromium.
- Desktop/mobile storefront and analytics captures were inspected under `test-results/`; no clipping or broken responsive layout was found.

The build only emits non-failing unused-import warnings from TanStack’s packaged internals; application code and all required checks pass.
